provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the lilies work (2026-10-18): every character from the floras in the lilies notes (plantgen-claude project-files/lilies/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Lilium superbum, plant_name_id 280253.

growth_form.note: A bulbous herb with one leafy flowering stem a year, drawn by the forb form.

growth.note: Grown five years from seed, as a lily bulb takes three to five to flower; drawn at its third and fifth years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

allometry.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stems 1.2-2.8 m Its reference height is the middle of that range, 2.0 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stems 1.2-2.8 m

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves usually more or less evenly distributed along stem, in 6-24 whorls or partial whorls

traits.leaf_whorls.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): in 6-24 whorls. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaves_per_whorl.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): 3-20 leaves per whorl. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 7.1-26.1 x 0.7-2.7 cm. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 0.7-2.7 cm wide, 4-18 times longer than wide. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): blade narrowly elliptic, sometimes extremely so

traits.leaf_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): usually more or less horizontal and drooping at tips, distal leaves ascending in sun

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): inflorescences racemose, 1-22-flowered. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.flower_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowers pendent, not fragrant

traits.perianth_reflexion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): perianth Turk's-cap-shaped; sepals and petals reflexed less than 1/5 along length from base

traits.perianth_reflexion_from.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): reflexed less than 1/5 along length from base

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): yellow or yellow-orange proximally, red-orange or sometimes red, red-purple, orange or yellow barely suffused with red distally; drawn red-orange The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_spots.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): spotted magenta

traits.perianth_spot_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): spotted magenta The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.tepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): sepals 6.8-10.5 cm, petals 7-10.2 cm

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stamens strongly exserted

traits.anther_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): anthers magenta, occasionally purple or dull purple The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): pedicel 7.4-19.1 cm

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 2.9-6.2 x 1.7-2.5 cm

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 1.7-2.5 cm wide

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium superbum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowering summer (Jul-early Aug)
